title: Perceptive whole-body planning for multilegged robots in confined spaces
publication: Journal of Field Robotics 38, 68–84; first online 2020
review_depth: publisher full text, methods and experiments
note: Body pose, foothold and swing trajectory planning; onboard depth; real ANYmal. Strong predecessor, not evidence that dense fragile clutter is solved.

title: Collision-Free MPC for Legged Robots in Static and Dynamic Scenes
authors: Magnus Gaertner, Marko Bjelonic, Farbod Farshidian, Marco Hutter
publication: arXiv primary abstract; ICRA bibliographic record
note: Collision-aware MPC with dynamics and kinematics. Exact contact protocol and complete experiments still to audit.

title: Barkour: Benchmarking Animal-level Agility with Quadruped Robots
note: Dog-agility-inspired benchmark. Do not reuse earlier unverified pole-spacing or 100% claims.

title: Walking in Narrow Spaces: Safety-critical Locomotion Control for Quadrupedal Robots with Duality-based Optimization
authors: Qiayuan Liao, Zhongyu Li, Akshay Thirugnanam, Jun Zeng, Koushil Sreenath
review_depth: abstract and author-hosted paper search record
note: NMPC/WBC with duality-based polytopic collision constraints. Need to audit body/leg abstraction and sensing assumptions before baseline use.

title: Hierarchical Vision Navigation System for Quadruped Robots with Foothold Adaptation Learning
authors: Junli Ren, Yingru Dai, Bowen Liu, Pengwei Xie, Guijin Wang
review_depth: publisher indexed text and author-article abstract via PubMed; direct publisher fetch failed
note: Hierarchical visual navigation plus learned foothold adaptation; simulation and real experiments reported. Full metric/contact audit pending.

title: Learning to walk in confined spaces using 3D representation
authors: Takahiro Miki, Joonho Lee, Lorenz Wellhausen, Marco Hutter
review_depth: full HTML methods and evaluation definitions
note: Hierarchical 3D representation, posture commands, teacher/student training; confined rough terrain. Not a dense thin-object zero-contact benchmark.

title: Agile But Safe: Learning Collision-Free High-Speed Legged Locomotion
authors: Tairan He, Chong Zhang, Wenli Xiao, Guanqi He, Changliu Liu, Guanya Shi
note: Agile/recovery policies with reach-avoid value; onboard sensing/computation. Important safety predecessor; per-link thin-clutter protocol still to audit.

title: Learning diverse natural behaviors for enhancing the agility of quadrupedal robots
review_depth: publisher main text, results and challenge criterion
note: Dog-motion-derived behavior controllers and depth-based task control. Explicitly requires reaching end without knocking obstacles over; no-knockdown alone is NOT novel.

title: SCAN-Planner: Spatial Collision-Aware Local Planning for Route-Guided Long-Range Quadruped Navigation
authors: Han Zheng, Zhe Chen, Yiwen Fu, Ming Yang, Tong Qin
publication: arXiv preprint v1; journal acceptance not verified
review_depth: full HTML, abstract and body collision section
note: Yaw-aware twin-cylinder body model and 3D local planning. Whole-body here is a navigation body abstraction, not evidence of joint optimization of all four swing-leg trajectories.

title: Collision-Free Humanoid Traversal in Cluttered Indoor Scenes
review_depth: full HTML methods and evaluation, plus author project metadata
note: Humanoid, NOT quadruped; relevant boundary literature on body-obstacle representations. Changing embodiment does not alone establish novelty.

title: Watch Your Step: Learning Semantically-Guided Locomotion in Cluttered Environment
authors: Denan Liang, Yuan Zhu, Ruimeng Liu, Thien-Minh Nguyen, Shenghai Yuan, Lihua Xie
review_depth: full HTML methods, training and real-world evaluation
note: SemLoco is directly related prior art for fragile low-object avoidance; includes non-foot collision penalties and Isaac Lab training. No official implementation was reproduced.

title: Neural Volumetric Memory for Visual Locomotion Control
authors: Ruihan Yang, Ge Yang, Xiaolong Wang
publication: CVPR 2023, confirmed by author arXiv comments
review_depth: primary abstract and author project page
note: Aligned volumetric memory from past forward-facing depth views; memory and SE(3) alignment alone are not new contributions.

title: Learning robust perceptive locomotion for quadrupedal robots in the wild
note: Attention-based recurrent proprioceptive/exteroceptive integration; perception reliability and recurrence have strong precedents.

title: DTC: Deep Tracking Control
authors: Fabian Jenelten, Junzhe He, Farbod Farshidian, Marco Hutter
review_depth: primary abstract, revision and DOI metadata
note: Model-based reference planning with learned tracking; prioritize control precision baseline. No third-party reimplementation is endorsed as official.

title: Extreme Parkour with Legged Robots
authors: Xuxin Cheng, Kexin Shi, Ananye Agarwal, Deepak Pathak
publication: arXiv primary record; later venue not relied on here
review_depth: primary abstract and author project page
note: Front depth camera and learned high-dynamic locomotion; objective differs from fragile-clutter contact preservation.

title: ANYmal Parkour: Learning Agile Navigation for Quadrupedal Robots
authors: David Hoeller, Nikita Rudin, Dhionis Sako, Marco Hutter
review_depth: primary abstract and author publication metadata
note: Hierarchical agility is relevant but not proof of our contact-sensitive benchmark.

title: ViPlanner: Visual Semantic Imperative Learning for Local Navigation
authors: Pascal Roth, Julian Nubert, Fan Yang, Mayank Mittal, Marco Hutter
review_depth: primary abstract and author project page
note: Semantic local navigation is not an all-leg collision-free controller; potential surrounding baseline/tooling, not locally reproduced.
